verses.sloka: स दीनो दीनया वाचा लक्ष्मणम् वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् ।शीघ्रम् लक्ष्मण जानीहि गत्वा गोदावरीम् नदीम् ॥३-६४-१॥
verses.transliteration: sa dīno dīnayā vācā lakṣmaṇam vākyam abravīt ।śīghram lakṣmaṇa jānīhi gatvā godāvarīm nadīm ॥3-64-1॥

translations.english: Rama in dejection said these pitiable words to Lakshmana,O Lakashmana, go swiftly to the river Godavari and find out if Sita has gone there to get lotuses.

verses.sloka: अपि गोदावरीम् सीता पद्मानि आनयितुम् गता ।एवम् उक्तः तु रामेण लक्ष्मणः पुनः एव हि ॥३-६४-२॥
verses.transliteration: api godāvarīm sītā padmāni ānayitum gatā ।evam uktaḥ tu rāmeṇa lakṣmaṇaḥ punaḥ eva hi ॥3-64-2॥

translations.english: Lakshmana, destroyer of enemywarriors, went to the beautiful river Godavari with quick steps following the instruction of Rama.

verses.sloka: नदीम् गोदावरीम् रम्याम् जगाम लघु विक्रमः ।ताम् लक्ष्मणः तीर्थवतीम् विचित्वा रामम् अब्रवीत् ॥३-६४-३॥
verses.transliteration: nadīm godāvarīm ramyām jagāma laghu vikramaḥ ।tām lakṣmaṇaḥ tīrthavatīm vicitvā rāmam abravīt ॥3-64-3॥

translations.english: Searching for Sita at the landings of river Godavari, Lakshmana said to Rama, I am unable to find her at these landings.No one responds to my call.

verses.sloka: नैनाम् पश्यामि तीर्थेषु क्रोशतो न शृणोति मे ।कम् नु सा देशम् आपन्ना वैदेही क्लेश नाशिनी ॥३-६४-४॥
verses.transliteration: nainām paśyāmi tīrtheṣu krośato na śṛṇoti me ।kam nu sā deśam āpannā vaidehī kleśa nāśinī ॥3-64-4॥

translations.english: Where could Vaidehi, destroyer of sorrow, go? I wonder. I am unable to trace the spot where the daughter of Janaka could be found.
translations.hindi: आप दयालु स्वभाव, जितेन्द्रिय और भ्राशिमात्र के हित में रत द्दोकर, इस ससय क्रोध के वशबर्ती हो, अपने स्वभाब को न 'त्यागिए

verses.sloka: न हि तम् वेद्मि वै राम यत्र सा तनु मध्यमा ।लक्ष्मणस्य वचः श्रुत्वा दीनः संताप मोहितः ॥३-६४-५॥
verses.transliteration: na hi tam vedmi vai rāma yatra sā tanu madhyamā ।lakṣmaṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā dīnaḥ saṁtāpa mohitaḥ ॥3-64-5॥

translations.english: Overwhelmed with grief on hearing Lakshmana's words, Rama himself went to river Godavari, and shouted, where are you, Sita?
translations.hindi: जैसे चन्द्रमा में श्री, सूर्य में प्रभा, वायु में गति और प्रवी में क्षमा नियमित रूप से रहती हे, वैसे ही आपमें इन चारों गुणो के सहित उत्तम यश स्थित है

verses.sloka: रामः समभिचक्राम स्वयम् गोदावरीम् नदीम् ।स ताम् उपस्थितो रामः क्व सीते इति एवम् अब्रवीत् ॥३-६४-६॥
verses.transliteration: rāmaḥ samabhicakrāma svayam godāvarīm nadīm ।sa tām upasthito rāmaḥ kva sīte iti evam abravīt ॥3-64-6॥

translations.english: Overwhelmed with grief on hearing Lakshmana's words, Rama himself went to river Godavari, and shouted, where are you, Sita?
translations.hindi: आपको यह उचित नहीं कि, एक के अपराध से सम्पूर्ण जगत का नाश करें | अभी तो यह भी नहीं मालूम कि, यह किसका भ्र्जशत्रों सहित तथा सपरिकर संग्राम रथ टूट पड़ा है और किसने और क्यों इसको तोड़ा हे । यह स्थान घोड़ों के खुरों और रथ के पहियों से खुदा हुआ तथा लोटू की बँदों से छिटकाया इअ देख पड़ता हे

verses.sloka: भूतानि राक्षसेन्द्रेण वध अर्हेण हृताम् अपि ।न ताम् शशंसू रामाय तथा गोदावरी नदी ॥३-६४-७॥
verses.transliteration: bhūtāni rākṣasendreṇa vadha arheṇa hṛtām api ।na tām śaśaṁsū rāmāya tathā godāvarī nadī ॥3-64-7॥

translations.english: Like the elements of Nature, river Godavari did not disclose Rama that Sita had been abducted by the king of demons who deserved death.

verses.sloka: ततः प्रचोदिता भूतैः शंस च अस्मै प्रियाम् इति ।न च सा हि अवदत् सीताम् पृष्टा रामेण शोचता ॥३-६४-८॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ pracoditā bhūtaiḥ śaṁsa ca asmai priyām iti ।na ca sā hi avadat sītām pṛṣṭā rāmeṇa śocatā ॥3-64-8॥

translations.english: River Godavari (although) prompted by creatures (of Nature) to tell him about his beloved did not respond to brooding Rama.

verses.sloka: रावणस्य च तत् रूपम् कर्माणि च दुरात्मनः ।ध्यात्वा भयात् तु वैदेहीम् सा नदी न शशंस ह ॥३-६४-९॥
verses.transliteration: rāvaṇasya ca tat rūpam karmāṇi ca durātmanaḥ ।dhyātvā bhayāt tu vaidehīm sā nadī na śaśaṁsa ha ॥3-64-9॥

translations.english: Remembering the evilminded Ravana's appearance and action, the river revealed nothing about Vaidehi out of fear.

verses.sloka: निराशः तु तया नद्या सीताया दर्शने कृतः ।उवाच रामः सौमित्रिम् सीता दर्शन कर्शितः ॥३-६४-१०॥
verses.transliteration: nirāśaḥ tu tayā nadyā sītāyā darśane kṛtaḥ ।uvāca rāmaḥ saumitrim sītā darśana karśitaḥ ॥3-64-10॥

translations.english: Disappointed by the river and emaciated by not being able to see Sita, Rama said to Lakshmana :
translations.hindi: राजा लोग अपराध के अनुसार दण्ड देने वाले होने पर भी दयाल और शान्त स्वभाव हुआ करते हें और आप तो सदा सब प्राणियों को शरण देने वाले ऑर उनको परसगति हुँ

verses.sloka: एषा गोदावरी सौम्य किंचन् न प्रतिभाषते ।किम् नु लक्ष्मण वक्ष्यामि समेत्य जनकम् वचः ॥३-६४-११॥
verses.transliteration: eṣā godāvarī saumya kiṁcan na pratibhāṣate ।kim nu lakṣmaṇa vakṣyāmi sametya janakam vacaḥ ॥3-64-11॥

translations.english: O handsome Lakshmana this Godavari does not at all respond. How can I go to Janaka and my mother without Sita and break this unhappy news?
translations.hindi: हे राघव ! आपकी खरी का नष्ट होता कोन अच्छा मानता है । नदी, समुद्र, पवत, देब, गन्धव ओर दानव

verses.sloka: मातरम् चैव वैदेह्या विना ताम् अहम् अप्रियम् ।या मे राज्य विहीनस्य वने वन्येन जीवतः ॥३-६४-१२॥
verses.transliteration: mātaram caiva vaidehyā vinā tām aham apriyam ।yā me rājya vihīnasya vane vanyena jīvataḥ ॥3-64-12॥

translations.english: Where could have gone that Vaidehi, who removed all my sorrows and sufferings when I lost my kingdom and survived on food available in the forest?
translations.hindi: नालं ते विम्रियं कत दीक्षितस्येव साधवः? । येन राजन्‌ हुता सीता तमन्वेषितुमहसि । १२ इनमें से कोई भी आपका विगाइ नहीं कर सकता, जैसे ऋर्विज्ञ यज्ञ दीक्षा प्राप्त पुरुष का अप्रिय नहीं कर सकते। हे राजन्‌ ! जिसने सीता चुराई है, उसको दूढना चाहिए

verses.sloka: सर्वम् व्यपनयत् शोकम् वैदेही क्व नु सा गता ।ज्ञाति वर्ग विहीनस्य राज पुत्रीम् अपश्यतः ॥३-६४-१३॥
verses.transliteration: sarvam vyapanayat śokam vaidehī kva nu sā gatā ।jñāti varga vihīnasya rāja putrīm apaśyataḥ ॥3-64-13॥

translations.english: Away from relatives and away from the princess, I keep awake during nights which seem too long.

verses.sloka: मन्ये दीर्घा भविष्यन्ति रात्रयो मम जाग्रतः ।मंदाकिनीम् जनस्थानम् इमम् प्रस्रवणम् गिरिम् ॥३-६४-१४॥
verses.transliteration: manye dīrghā bhaviṣyanti rātrayo mama jāgrataḥ ।maṁdākinīm janasthānam imam prasravaṇam girim ॥3-64-14॥

translations.english: I will roam about the river Godavari, Janasthana and this mount Prasravana till I find Sita.

verses.sloka: सर्वाणि अनुचरिष्यामि यदि सीता हि लभ्यते ।एते महा मृगा वीर माम् ईक्षन्ते पुनः पुनः ॥३-६४-१५॥
verses.transliteration: sarvāṇi anucariṣyāmi yadi sītā hi labhyate ।ete mahā mṛgā vīra mām īkṣante punaḥ punaḥ ॥3-64-15॥

translations.english: O mighty Lakshmana these deer are looking at me again and again indicating that they wish to tell me something.

verses.sloka: वक्तु कामा इह हि मे इंगितानि अनुपलक्षये ।तान् तु दृष्ट्वा नरव्याघ्र राघवः प्रत्युवाच ह ॥३-६४-१६॥
verses.transliteration: vaktu kāmā iha hi me iṁgitāni anupalakṣaye ।tān tu dṛṣṭvā naravyāghra rāghavaḥ pratyuvāca ha ॥3-64-16॥

translations.english: With his vision blurred by tears, Rama, the best among men, looked at them and asked them 'Where is Sita'?

verses.sloka: क्व सीत इति निरीक्षन् वै बाष्प संरुद्धया गिरा ।एवम् उक्ता नरेन्द्रेण ते मृगाः सहसा उत्थिता ॥३-६४-१७॥
verses.transliteration: kva sīta iti nirīkṣan vai bāṣpa saṁruddhayā girā ।evam uktā narendreṇa te mṛgāḥ sahasā utthitā ॥3-64-17॥

translations.english: Thus asked by the prince, all the deer got up suddenly, and pointed towards the southern sky, the direction in which the princess from Mithila was carried off. Looking at the Lord of men (Rama), they started running in that direction.

verses.sloka: दक्षिण अभिमुखाः सर्वे दर्शयन्तो नभः स्थलम् ।मैथिली ह्रियमाणा सा दिशम् याम् अभ्यपद्यत ॥३-६४-१८॥
verses.transliteration: dakṣiṇa abhimukhāḥ sarve darśayanto nabhaḥ sthalam ।maithilī hriyamāṇā sā diśam yām abhyapadyata ॥3-64-18॥

translations.english: Thus asked by the prince, all the deer got up suddenly, and pointed towards the southern sky, the direction in which the princess from Mithila was carried off. Looking at the Lord of men (Rama), they started running in that direction.

verses.sloka: तेन मार्गेण गच्छन्तो निरीक्षन्तो नराधिपम् ।येन मार्गम् च भूमिम् च निरीक्षन्ते स्म ते मृगाः ॥३-६४-१९॥
verses.transliteration: tena mārgeṇa gacchanto nirīkṣanto narādhipam ।yena mārgam ca bhūmim ca nirīkṣante sma te mṛgāḥ ॥3-64-19॥

translations.english: Even Lakshmana marked that the deer were showing and looking at the path lying in that direction.

verses.sloka: पुनः नदन्तो गच्छन्ति लक्ष्मणेन उपलक्षिताः ।तेषाम् वचन सर्वस्वम् लक्षयामास च इन्गितम् ॥३-६४-२०॥
verses.transliteration: punaḥ nadanto gacchanti lakṣmaṇena upalakṣitāḥ ।teṣām vacana sarvasvam lakṣayāmāsa ca ingitam ॥3-64-20॥

translations.english: Observing intelligently their indications and understanding the meaning of their message, Lakshmana said to his distressed elder brother:

verses.sloka: उवाच लक्ष्मणो धीमान् ज्येष्ठम् भ्रातरम् आर्तवत् ।क्व सीत इति त्वया पृष्टा यथा इमे सहसा उथिताः ॥३-६४-२१॥
verses.transliteration: uvāca lakṣmaṇo dhīmān jyeṣṭham bhrātaram ārtavat ।kva sīta iti tvayā pṛṣṭā yathā ime sahasā uthitāḥ ॥3-64-21॥

translations.english: O lord these deer are indicating the land on the southern side.Therefore it will be proper for both of us to proceed in the southwestern direction. Maybe we will get some clue or find that noble Sita.

verses.sloka: दर्शयन्ति क्षितिम् चैव दक्षिणाम् च दिशम् मृगाः ।सधु गच्छावहे देव दिशम् एताम् च नैर्ऋतीम् ॥३-६४-२२॥
verses.transliteration: darśayanti kṣitim caiva dakṣiṇām ca diśam mṛgāḥ ।sadhu gacchāvahe deva diśam etām ca nairṛtīm ॥3-64-22॥

translations.english: O lord these deer are indicating the land on the southern side.Therefore it will be proper for both of us to proceed in the southwestern direction. Maybe we will get some clue or find that noble Sita.

verses.sloka: यदि तस्य आगमः कश्चित् आर्या वा सा अथ लक्ष्यते ।बाढम् इति एव काकुत्स्थः प्रस्थितो दक्षिणाम् दिशम् ॥३-६४-२३॥
verses.transliteration: yadi tasya āgamaḥ kaścit āryā vā sā atha lakṣyate ।bāḍham iti eva kākutsthaḥ prasthito dakṣiṇām diśam ॥3-64-23॥

translations.english: Handsome Rama said, 'yes'and started in southern direction, carefully looking at the ground, followed by Lakshmana.

verses.sloka: लक्ष्मण अनुगत श्रीमान् वीक्ष्यमाणो वसुन्धराम् ।एवम् संभाषमाणौ तौ अन्योन्यम् भ्रातरौ उभौ ॥३-६४-२४॥
verses.transliteration: lakṣmaṇa anugata śrīmān vīkṣyamāṇo vasundharām ।evam saṁbhāṣamāṇau tau anyonyam bhrātarau ubhau ॥3-64-24॥

translations.english: Talking with each other, the two brothers took the path on earth strewn with flowers.

verses.sloka: वसुन्धरायाम् पतित पुष्प मार्गम् अपश्यताम् ।पुष्प वृष्टिम् निपतिताम् दृष्ट्वा रामो मही तले ॥३-६४-२५॥
verses.transliteration: vasundharāyām patita puṣpa mārgam apaśyatām ।puṣpa vṛṣṭim nipatitām dṛṣṭvā rāmo mahī tale ॥3-64-25॥

translations.english: Seeing showers of flowers fallen on the ground, valiant Rama sadly said these words to sorrowful Lakshmana:

verses.sloka: उवाच लक्ष्मणम् वीरो दुःखितो दुःखितम् वचः ।अभिजानामि पुष्पाणि तानि इमानि इह लक्ष्मण ॥३-६४-२६॥
verses.transliteration: uvāca lakṣmaṇam vīro duḥkhito duḥkhitam vacaḥ ।abhijānāmi puṣpāṇi tāni imāni iha lakṣmaṇa ॥3-64-26॥

translations.english: O Lakshmana, here are the same flowers I had given Vaidehi to wear in the forest. I can recognize them.

verses.sloka: अपिनद्धानि वैदेह्या मया दत्तानि कानने ।मन्ये सूर्यः च वायुः च मेदिनी च यशशिविनि ॥३-६४-२७॥
verses.transliteration: apinaddhāni vaidehyā mayā dattāni kānane ।manye sūryaḥ ca vāyuḥ ca medinī ca yaśaśivini ॥3-64-27॥

translations.english: I think the Sun, the wind and the famed earth have done me a favour by preserving these flowers.

verses.sloka: अभिरक्षन्ति पुष्पाणि प्रकुर्वन्तो मम प्रियम् ।एवम् उक्त्वा महाबाहुः लक्ष्मणम् पुरुषर्षभम् ॥३-६४-२८॥
verses.transliteration: abhirakṣanti puṣpāṇi prakurvanto mama priyam ।evam uktvā mahābāhuḥ lakṣmaṇam puruṣarṣabham ॥3-64-28॥

translations.english: Rigteous Rama, the best among men, having said these words to the longarmed Lakshmana, asked mount Prasravana, full of streams:

verses.sloka: उवाच रामो धर्मात्मा गिरिम् प्रसवण आकुलम् ।कच्चित् क्षिति भृताम् नाथ दृष्टा सर्वांग सुंदरीम् ॥३-६४-२९॥
verses.transliteration: uvāca rāmo dharmātmā girim prasavaṇa ākulam ।kaccit kṣiti bhṛtām nātha dṛṣṭā sarvāṁga suṁdarīm ॥3-64-29॥

translations.english: O king of the mountains have you seen a lady with beautiful limbs separated from me in this forest tract ?

verses.sloka: रामा रम्ये वनोद् देशे मया विरहिता त्वया ।क्रुद्धो अब्रवीत् गिरिम् तत्र सिंहः क्षुद्र मृगम् यथा ॥३-६४-३०॥
verses.transliteration: rāmā ramye vanod deśe mayā virahitā tvayā ।kruddho abravīt girim tatra siṁhaḥ kṣudra mṛgam yathā ॥3-64-30॥

translations.english: Like a lion aiming at a petty animal, angry Rama said, O Mountain before I destroy all your slopes show me that goldenhued Sita with lustre like gold.

verses.sloka: ताम् हेम वर्णाम् हेम अंगीम् सीताम् दर्शय पर्वत ।यावत् सानूनि सर्वाणि न ते विध्वंसयामि अहम् ॥३-६४-३१॥
verses.transliteration: tām hema varṇām hema aṁgīm sītām darśaya parvata ।yāvat sānūni sarvāṇi na te vidhvaṁsayāmi aham ॥3-64-31॥

translations.english: Like a lion aiming at a petty animal, angry Rama said, O Mountain before I destroy all your slopes show me that goldenhued Sita with lustre like gold.

verses.sloka: एवम् उक्तः तु रामेण पर्वतो मैथिलीम् प्रति ।दर्शयन् इव ताम् सीताम् न दर्शयत राघवे ॥३-६४-३२॥
verses.transliteration: evam uktaḥ tu rāmeṇa parvato maithilīm prati ।darśayan iva tām sītām na darśayata rāghave ॥3-64-32॥

translations.english: Thus addressed by Rama, the mountain echoed as if it was telling about Sita but did not show her to Rama.

verses.sloka: ततो दाशरथी राम उवाच शिलोच्चयम् ।मम बाण अग्नि निर्दग्धो भस्मी भूतो भविष्यसि ॥३-६४-३३॥
verses.transliteration: tato dāśarathī rāma uvāca śiloccayam ।mama bāṇa agni nirdagdho bhasmī bhūto bhaviṣyasi ॥3-64-33॥

translations.english: Rama, Dasaratha's son said to the mountain, The fire of my arrows will reduce you to ashes.You will have no grass, no tree, no twig. You will be unfit to be served any more.

verses.sloka: असेव्यः सततम् चैव निस्तृण द्रुम पल्लवः ।इमाम् वा सरितम् च अद्य शोषयिष्यामि लक्ष्मण ॥३-६४-३४॥
verses.transliteration: asevyaḥ satatam caiva nistṛṇa druma pallavaḥ ।imām vā saritam ca adya śoṣayiṣyāmi lakṣmaṇa ॥3-64-34॥

translations.english: O Lakshmana if this river does not tell me about that noble Sita with countenance like the moon, I will drain it dry right now.

verses.sloka: यदि न आख्याति मे सीताम् अद्य चन्द्र निभ आननाम् ।एवम् प्ररुषितो रामो दिधक्षन् इव चक्षुषा ॥३-६४-३५॥
verses.transliteration: yadi na ākhyāti me sītām adya candra nibha ānanām ।evam praruṣito rāmo didhakṣan iva cakṣuṣā ॥3-64-35॥

translations.english: While Rama was angry with his eyes burning, he saw on the ground as he advanced large footprints of a demon and then the footprints of Maithili which signified as if chased by the demon, she was frightened and was running hither and thither, longing to see Rama.

verses.sloka: ददर्श भूमौ निष्क्रांतम् राक्षसस्य पदम् महत् ।त्रस्तया राम काङ्क्षिण्याः प्रधावन्त्या इतः ततः ॥३-६४-३६॥
verses.transliteration: dadarśa bhūmau niṣkrāṁtam rākṣasasya padam mahat ।trastayā rāma kāṅkṣiṇyāḥ pradhāvantyā itaḥ tataḥ ॥3-64-36॥

translations.english: While Rama was angry with his eyes burning, he saw on the ground as he advanced large footprints of a demon and then the footprints of Maithili which signified as if chased by the demon, she was frightened and was running hither and thither, longing to see Rama.

verses.sloka: राक्षसेन अनुवृत्तया वैदेह्या च पादानि तु ।स समीक्ष्य परिक्रान्तम् सीताया राक्षसस्य च ॥३-६४-३७॥
verses.transliteration: rākṣasena anuvṛttayā vaidehyā ca pādāni tu ।sa samīkṣya parikrāntam sītāyā rākṣasasya ca ॥3-64-37॥

translations.english: Bewildered to see the broken bow and quiver and many splinters of the chariot scattered all over, Rama said to his loving brother Lakshmana:

verses.sloka: भंगम् धनुः च तूणी च विकीर्णाम् बहुधा रथम् ।संभ्रांत हृदयो रामः शशंस भ्रातरम् प्रियम् ॥३-६४-३८॥
verses.transliteration: bhaṁgam dhanuḥ ca tūṇī ca vikīrṇām bahudhā ratham ।saṁbhrāṁta hṛdayo rāmaḥ śaśaṁsa bhrātaram priyam ॥3-64-38॥

translations.english: Bewildered to see the broken bow and quiver and many splinters of the chariot scattered all over, Rama said to his loving brother Lakshmana:

verses.sloka: पश्य लक्ष्मण वैदेह्याः कीर्णाम् कनक बिन्दवः ।भूषणानाम् हि सौमित्रे माल्यानि विविधानि च ॥३-६४-३९॥
verses.transliteration: paśya lakṣmaṇa vaidehyāḥ kīrṇām kanaka bindavaḥ ।bhūṣaṇānām hi saumitre mālyāni vividhāni ca ॥3-64-39॥

translations.english: O Saumitri see the many broken bits of gold ornaments and garlands.

verses.sloka: तप्त बिन्दु निकाशैः च चित्रैः क्षतज बिन्दुभिः ।आवृतम् पश्य सौमित्रे सर्वतो धरणी तलम् ॥३-६४-४०॥
verses.transliteration: tapta bindu nikāśaiḥ ca citraiḥ kṣataja bindubhiḥ ।āvṛtam paśya saumitre sarvato dharaṇī talam ॥3-64-40॥

translations.english: See, O Lakshmana, the patches of blood looking like drops of shining gold spread all over the ground.

verses.sloka: मन्ये लक्ष्मण वैदेही राक्षसैः काम रूपिभिः ।भित्त्वा भित्त्वा विभक्ता वा भक्षिता वा भविष्यति ॥३-६४-४१॥
verses.transliteration: manye lakṣmaṇa vaidehī rākṣasaiḥ kāma rūpibhiḥ ।bhittvā bhittvā vibhaktā vā bhakṣitā vā bhaviṣyati ॥3-64-41॥

translations.english: O Lakshmana, Vaidehi might have been cut into pieces, and eaten up by the demons who can assume any form at their free will.

verses.sloka: तस्या निमित्तम् वैदेह्या द्वयोः विवदमानयोः ।बभूव युद्धम् सौमित्रे घोरम् राक्षसयोः इह ॥३-६४-४२॥
verses.transliteration: tasyā nimittam vaidehyā dvayoḥ vivadamānayoḥ ।babhūva yuddham saumitre ghoram rākṣasayoḥ iha ॥3-64-42॥

translations.english: O Lakshmana, two demons might have fought a dreadful duel at this place contesting with each other for the sake of Vaidehi.

verses.sloka: मुक्ता मणि चितम् च इदम् तपनीय विभूषितम् ।धरण्याम् पतितम् सौम्य कस्य भग्नम् महत् धनुः ॥३-६४-४३॥
verses.transliteration: muktā maṇi citam ca idam tapanīya vibhūṣitam ।dharaṇyām patitam saumya kasya bhagnam mahat dhanuḥ ॥3-64-43॥

translations.english: O handsome Lakshmana whose is this huge bow embedded with pearls and gems and adorned with gold fallen on the ground?

verses.sloka: राक्षसानाम् इदम् वस्त सुराणाम् अधवा अपि ।तरुण आदित्य संकाशम् वैदूर्य गुलिका चितम् ॥३-६४-४४॥
verses.transliteration: rākṣasānām idam vasta surāṇām adhavā api ।taruṇa āditya saṁkāśam vaidūrya gulikā citam ॥3-64-44॥

translations.english: Whose is this shield of gold studded with Vaidurya, broken and strewn all over the ground, shining like the morning Sun?

verses.sloka: विशीर्णम् पतितम् भूमौ कवचम् कस्य कांचनम् ।छत्रम् शत शलाकम् च दिव्य माल्य उपशोभितम् ॥३-६४-४५॥
verses.transliteration: viśīrṇam patitam bhūmau kavacam kasya kāṁcanam ।chatram śata śalākam ca divya mālya upaśobhitam ॥3-64-45॥

translations.english: Whose parasol is this with a hundred spokes, festooned with wonderful flowers thrown down on the ground with broken staff ?

verses.sloka: भग्न दण्डम् इदम् कस्य भूमौ सौम्य निपातितम् ।कान्चन उरः छदाः च इमे पिशाच वदनाः खराः ॥३-६४-४६॥
verses.transliteration: bhagna daṇḍam idam kasya bhūmau saumya nipātitam ।kāncana uraḥ chadāḥ ca ime piśāca vadanāḥ kharāḥ ॥3-64-46॥

translations.english: Whose are these donkeys, with golden chestcoverings, with the devil's face, fierceful and huge and slain in the encounter ?

verses.sloka: भीम रूपा महाकायाः कस्य वा निहता रणे ।दीप्त पावक संकाशो द्युतिमान् समर ध्वजः ॥३-६४-४७॥
verses.transliteration: bhīma rūpā mahākāyāḥ kasya vā nihatā raṇe ।dīpta pāvaka saṁkāśo dyutimān samara dhvajaḥ ॥3-64-47॥

translations.english: Whose war chariot with a battle flag is this, shining like burning fire, turned upside down and broken?

verses.sloka: अपविद्धः च भग्नः च कस्य सांग्रामिको रथः ।रथ अक्ष मात्रा विशिखाः तपनीय विभूषणाः ॥३-६४-४८॥
verses.transliteration: apaviddhaḥ ca bhagnaḥ ca kasya sāṁgrāmiko rathaḥ ।ratha akṣa mātrā viśikhāḥ tapanīya vibhūṣaṇāḥ ॥3-64-48॥

translations.english: Whose are these pointless arrows of the size of a chariot axle adorned with bright gold destroyed and scattered ? Who is he that has performed such terrible deeds?

verses.sloka: कस्य इमे निहता बाणाः प्रकीर्णा घोर दर्शनः ।शरावरौ शरैः पूर्णौ विध्वस्तौ पश्य लक्ष्मण ॥३-६४-४९॥
verses.transliteration: kasya ime nihatā bāṇāḥ prakīrṇā ghora darśanaḥ ।śarāvarau śaraiḥ pūrṇau vidhvastau paśya lakṣmaṇa ॥3-64-49॥

translations.english: O Lakshmana look at these two quivers filled with arrows and lying shattered. The charioteer is holding a whip and reins in his hands and is lying dead. To whom do they belong?

verses.sloka: प्रतोद अभीशु हस्तो अयम् कस्य वा सारथिः हतः ।पदवी पुरुषस्य एषा व्यक्तम् कस्य अपि राक्षसः ॥३-६४-५०॥
verses.transliteration: pratoda abhīśu hasto ayam kasya vā sārathiḥ hataḥ ।padavī puruṣasya eṣā vyaktam kasya api rākṣasaḥ ॥3-64-50॥

translations.english: O best among men, O handsome Lakshmana see these carriers of fans with head dress and earrings studded with gems lying slain in the combat. Whose are they ?

verses.sloka: वैरम् शत गुणम् पश्य मम तैः जीवित अंतकम् ।सुघोर हृदयैः सौम्य राक्षसैः काम रूपिभिः ॥३-६४-५१॥
verses.transliteration: vairam śata guṇam paśya mama taiḥ jīvita aṁtakam ।sughora hṛdayaiḥ saumya rākṣasaiḥ kāma rūpibhiḥ ॥3-64-51॥

translations.english: This indeed is the path the man or the demon has traversed. My enmity with him now has become hundredfold. This will end only with the extermination of his life.

verses.sloka: हृता मृता वा सीता हि भक्षिता वा तपस्विनी ।न धर्मः त्रायते सीताम् ह्रियमाणाम् महावने ॥३-६४-५२॥
verses.transliteration: hṛtā mṛtā vā sītā hi bhakṣitā vā tapasvinī ।na dharmaḥ trāyate sītām hriyamāṇām mahāvane ॥3-64-52॥

translations.english: O handsome one, those demons can change their form at will and are of dreadful nature. Have they abducted or devoured or killed her in this great forest. Even her righteousness could not protect the helpless Sita.

verses.sloka: भक्षितायाम् हि वैदेह्याम् हृतायाम् अपि लक्ष्मण ।के हि लोके प्रियम् कर्तुम् शक्ताः सौम्य मम ईश्वराः ॥३-६४-५३॥
verses.transliteration: bhakṣitāyām hi vaidehyām hṛtāyām api lakṣmaṇa ।ke hi loke priyam kartum śaktāḥ saumya mama īśvarāḥ ॥3-64-53॥

translations.english: If Sita has been devoured or kidnapped, none in this world or even gods could do anything to make me happy, O handsome Lakshmana

verses.sloka: कर्तारम् अपि लोकानाम् शूरम् करुण वेदिनम् ।अज्ञानात् अवमन्येरन् सर्व भूतानि लक्ष्मण ॥३-६४-५४॥
verses.transliteration: kartāram api lokānām śūram karuṇa vedinam ।ajñānāt avamanyeran sarva bhūtāni lakṣmaṇa ॥3-64-54॥

translations.english: O Lakshmana even the compassionate and heroic Creator of the worlds will be disrespected by all beings, however ignorantly (if such things are allowed to happen).

verses.sloka: मृदुम् लोक हिते युक्तम् दांतम् करुण वेदिनम् ।निर्वीर्य इति मन्यन्ते नूनम् माम् त्रिदश ईश्वराः ॥३-६४-५५॥
verses.transliteration: mṛdum loka hite yuktam dāṁtam karuṇa vedinam ।nirvīrya iti manyante nūnam mām tridaśa īśvarāḥ ॥3-64-55॥

translations.english: The gods will certainly consider me a man engaged in the welfare of the world, a man of selfrestraint and compassion, but at the same time a weak man.

verses.sloka: माम् प्राप्य हि गुणो दोषः संवृत्तः पश्य लक्ष्मण ।अद्य एव सर्व भूतानाम् रक्षसाम् अभवाय च ॥३-६४-५६॥
verses.transliteration: mām prāpya hi guṇo doṣaḥ saṁvṛttaḥ paśya lakṣmaṇa ।adya eva sarva bhūtānām rakṣasām abhavāya ca ॥3-64-56॥

translations.english: O Lakshmana even demerits turn into merits when they come in contact with me. Just as the Sun shines, effacing the moonlight, my brilliance will outshine my demerits of exterminating all (wicked) beings including the demons.

verses.sloka: संहृत्य एव शशि ज्योत्स्नाम् महान् सूर्य इव उदितः ।संहृत्य एव गुणान् सर्वान् मम तेजः प्रकाश्ते ॥३-६४-५७॥
verses.transliteration: saṁhṛtya eva śaśi jyotsnām mahān sūrya iva uditaḥ ।saṁhṛtya eva guṇān sarvān mama tejaḥ prakāśte ॥3-64-57॥

translations.english: O Lakshmana even demerits turn into merits when they come in contact with me. Just as the Sun shines, effacing the moonlight, my brilliance will outshine my demerits of exterminating all (wicked) beings including the demons.

verses.sloka: न एव यक्षा न गंधर्वा न पिशाचा न राक्षसाः ।किन्नरा वा मनुष्या वा सुखम् प्राप्स्यन्ति लक्ष्मण ॥३-६४-५८॥
verses.transliteration: na eva yakṣā na gaṁdharvā na piśācā na rākṣasāḥ ।kinnarā vā manuṣyā vā sukham prāpsyanti lakṣmaṇa ॥3-64-58॥

translations.english: O Lakshmana, neither yakshas, nor goblins nor demons nor kinneras nor humans will be in peace now.

verses.sloka: मम अस्त्र बाण संपूर्णम् आकाशम् पश्य लक्ष्मण ।असंपातम् करिष्यामि हि अद्य त्रैलोक्य चारिणाम् ॥३-६४-५९॥
verses.transliteration: mama astra bāṇa saṁpūrṇam ākāśam paśya lakṣmaṇa ।asaṁpātam kariṣyāmi hi adya trailokya cāriṇām ॥3-64-59॥

translations.english: O Lakshmana, just see, I will fill the sky with all my weapons and arrows and make all movements impossible in the three worlds.

verses.sloka: संनिरुद्धग्रहगणमावारितनिशाकरम् ।विप्रनष्टानलमरुद्भास्करद्युतिसंवृतम्।यद्व -संनिरुद्ध ग्रह गणम् आवारित निशा करम् ।विप्रनष्ट अनल मरुत् भास्कर द्युति संवृतम् ॥३-६४-६०॥
verses.transliteration: saṁniruddhagrahagaṇamāvāritaniśākaram ।vipranaṣṭānalamarudbhāskaradyutisaṁvṛtam।yadva -saṁniruddha graha gaṇam āvārita niśā karam ।vipranaṣṭa anala marut bhāskara dyuti saṁvṛtam ॥3-64-60॥

translations.english: I will obstruct the movement of planets and the Moon, destroy the radiance of the Sun, the fire and block the wind crush the mountain tops, dry up the tanks, destroy the trees shrubs and creepers and annihilate the oceans. I shall bring about this fatal change at once in the three worlds.

verses.sloka: विनिर्मथितशैलाग्रम्शुष्यमाणजलाअशयम् ।ध्वस्तद्रुमलतागुल्मम्विप्रणाशितसागरम्।यद्वा -विनिर्मथित शैल अग्रम् शुष्यमाण जल आशयम् ।ध्वस्त द्रुम लता गुल्मम् विप्रणाशित सागरम् ॥३-६४-६१॥
verses.transliteration: vinirmathitaśailāgramśuṣyamāṇajalāaśayam ।dhvastadrumalatāgulmamvipraṇāśitasāgaram।yadvā -vinirmathita śaila agram śuṣyamāṇa jala āśayam ।dhvasta druma latā gulmam vipraṇāśita sāgaram ॥3-64-61॥

translations.english: I will obstruct the movement of planets and the Moon, destroy the radiance of the Sun, the fire and block the wind crush the mountain tops, dry up the tanks, destroy the trees shrubs and creepers and annihilate the oceans. I shall bring about this fatal change at once in the three worlds.

verses.sloka: त्रै लोक्यम् तु करिष्यामि संयुक्तम् काल कर्मणा ।न ते कुशलिनीम् सीताम् प्रदास्यन्ति मम ईश्वराः ॥३-६४-६२॥
verses.transliteration: trai lokyam tu kariṣyāmi saṁyuktam kāla karmaṇā ।na te kuśalinīm sītām pradāsyanti mama īśvarāḥ ॥3-64-62॥

translations.english: I will obstruct the movement of planets and the Moon, destroy the radiance of the Sun, the fire and block the wind crush the mountain tops, dry up the tanks, destroy the trees shrubs and creepers and annihilate the oceans. I shall bring about this fatal change at once in the three worlds.

verses.sloka: अस्मिन् मुहूर्ते सौमित्रे मम द्रक्ष्यन्ति विक्रमम् ।न आकाशम् उत्पतिष्यन्ति सर्व भूतानि लक्ष्मण ॥३-६४-६३॥
verses.transliteration: asmin muhūrte saumitre mama drakṣyanti vikramam ।na ākāśam utpatiṣyanti sarva bhūtāni lakṣmaṇa ॥3-64-63॥

translations.english: If the gods do not return my Sita safely to me, O Lakshmana they will witness my power right now.

verses.sloka: मम चाप गुण उन्मुक्तैः बाण जालैः निरंतरम् ।मर्दितम् मम नाराचैः ध्वस्त भ्रांत मृग द्विजम् ॥३-६४-६४॥
verses.transliteration: mama cāpa guṇa unmuktaiḥ bāṇa jālaiḥ niraṁtaram ।marditam mama nārācaiḥ dhvasta bhrāṁta mṛga dvijam ॥3-64-64॥

translations.english: Lakshmana no beings will be able to move in the sky, blocked by arrows released from my bowstring there will be no space left there.

verses.sloka: समाकुलम् अमर्यादम् जगत् पश्य अद्य लक्ष्मण ।आकर्णपूर्णैरिषुभिर्जीवलोकंदुरावरैः।यद्वा -आकर्ण पूर्णैर् इषुभिर् जीव लोकम् दुरावरैः ॥३-६४-६५॥
verses.transliteration: samākulam amaryādam jagat paśya adya lakṣmaṇa ।ākarṇapūrṇairiṣubhirjīvalokaṁdurāvaraiḥ।yadvā -ākarṇa pūrṇair iṣubhir jīva lokam durāvaraiḥ ॥3-64-65॥

translations.english: O Lakshmna now beasts and birds will be confused and destroyed by my darts.You will see them crossing all limits of propriety.

verses.sloka: करिष्ये मैथिली हेतोः अपिशाचम् अराक्षसम् ।मम रोष प्रयुक्तानाम् विशिखानाम् बलम् सुराः ॥३-६४-६६॥
verses.transliteration: kariṣye maithilī hetoḥ apiśācam arākṣasam ।mama roṣa prayuktānām viśikhānām balam surāḥ ॥3-64-66॥

translations.english: For the sake of Maithili I will render this world devoid of goblins and demons with my irresistible arrows pulled up to my ears.

verses.sloka: द्रक्ष्यन्ति अद्य विमुक्तानाम् अमर्षात् दूर गामिनाम् ।न एव देवा न दैतेया न पिशाचा न राक्षसाः ॥३-६४-६७॥
verses.transliteration: drakṣyanti adya vimuktānām amarṣāt dūra gāminām ।na eva devā na daiteyā na piśācā na rākṣasāḥ ॥3-64-67॥

translations.english: Now the gods will witness the power of my arrows released in great rage which can hit distant targets.

verses.sloka: भविष्यन्ति मम क्रोधात् त्रैलोक्ये विप्रणाशिते ।देव दानव यक्षाणाम् लोका ये रक्षसाम् अपि ॥३-६४-६८॥
verses.transliteration: bhaviṣyanti mama krodhāt trailokye vipraṇāśite ।deva dānava yakṣāṇām lokā ye rakṣasām api ॥3-64-68॥

translations.english: My anger will destroy all the gods, demons and evil spirits. They will be extinghished from the three worlds.

verses.sloka: बहुधानिपतिष्यन्तिबाणोघैश्शकलीकृताः ।यद्वा -बहुधा नि पतिष्यन्ति बाण ओघैः शकली कृताः ।निर्मर्यादानिमाँल्लोकान्करिष्याम्यद्यसायकैः।यद्वा -निर् मर्यादान् इमान् लोकान् करिष्यामि अद्य सायकैः ॥३-६४-६९॥
verses.transliteration: bahudhānipatiṣyantibāṇoghaiśśakalīkṛtāḥ ।yadvā -bahudhā ni patiṣyanti bāṇa oghaiḥ śakalī kṛtāḥ ।nirmaryādānimām̐llokānkariṣyāmyadyasāyakaiḥ।yadvā -nir maryādān imān lokān kariṣyāmi adya sāyakaiḥ ॥3-64-69॥

translations.english: The worlds of gods, yakshas or even demons torn into shreds by my arrows will not survive.

verses.sloka: हृताम् मृताम् वा सौमित्रे न दास्यन्ति मम ईश्वराः ।तथा रूपम् हि वैदेहीम् न दास्यन्ति यदि प्रियाम् ॥३-६४-७०॥
verses.transliteration: hṛtām mṛtām vā saumitre na dāsyanti mama īśvarāḥ ।tathā rūpam hi vaidehīm na dāsyanti yadi priyām ॥3-64-70॥

translations.english: If the gods do not hand over Sita to me either carried away or dead I will transgress these worlds, O Lakshmana

verses.sloka: नाशयामि जगत् सर्वम् त्रैलोक्यम् स चर अचरम् ।यावत् दर्शनम् अस्या वै तापयामि च सायकैः ॥३-६४-७१॥
verses.transliteration: nāśayāmi jagat sarvam trailokyam sa cara acaram ।yāvat darśanam asyā vai tāpayāmi ca sāyakaiḥ ॥3-64-71॥

translations.english: If my beloved Vaidehi is not given back to me in her true form I will destroy the three worlds with all animate and inanimate beings.

verses.sloka: इति उक्त्वा क्रोध ताम्र अक्षः स्फुरमाण ओष्ट संपुटः ।वल्कल अजिनम् आबद्ध्य जटा भारम् बन्धयत् ॥३-६४-७२॥
verses.transliteration: iti uktvā krodha tāmra akṣaḥ sphuramāṇa oṣṭa saṁpuṭaḥ ।valkala ajinam ābaddhya jaṭā bhāram bandhayat ॥3-64-72॥

translations.english: After speaking these words, handsome Rama, his eyes red with anger, pressed his bow, took out the glowing arrow that was dreadful like a poisonous serpent, fixed it to his bow and said these words in a rage like the fire at the time of dissolution of the world.

verses.sloka: तस्य क्रुद्धस्य रामस्य तथा अभूतस्य धीमतः ।त्रि पुरम् जग्नुषः पूर्वम् रुद्रस्य इव बभौ तनुः ॥३-६४-७३॥
verses.transliteration: tasya kruddhasya rāmasya tathā abhūtasya dhīmataḥ ।tri puram jagnuṣaḥ pūrvam rudrasya iva babhau tanuḥ ॥3-64-73॥

translations.english: After speaking these words, handsome Rama, his eyes red with anger, pressed his bow, took out the glowing arrow that was dreadful like a poisonous serpent, fixed it to his bow and said these words in a rage like the fire at the time of dissolution of the world.

verses.sloka: लक्ष्मणात् अथ च आदाय रामो निष्पीड्य कार्मुकम् ।शरम् आदाय संदीप्तम् घोरम् अशी विष उपमम् ॥३-६४-७४॥
verses.transliteration: lakṣmaṇāt atha ca ādāya rāmo niṣpīḍya kārmukam ।śaram ādāya saṁdīptam ghoram aśī viṣa upamam ॥3-64-74॥

translations.english: Just as all beings in this world cannot avoid age and death, or defy time and fate so also none can prevent me at all when I am angry, O Lakshmana

verses.sloka: संदधे धनुषि श्रीमान् रामः पर पुरंजयः ।युग अन्त अग्निः इव क्रुद्धः इदम् वचनम् अब्रवीत् ॥३-६४-७५॥
verses.transliteration: saṁdadhe dhanuṣi śrīmān rāmaḥ para puraṁjayaḥ ।yuga anta agniḥ iva kruddhaḥ idam vacanam abravīt ॥3-64-75॥

translations.english: I will topsyturvy this entire world including the gods, the gandharvas, human beings, serpents and mountains if they do not show me the princess from Mithila, who is blemishless and whose teeth are beautiful इत्यार्शे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकेय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे चतुष्षष्टिमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the sixtyfourth sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

verses.sloka: यथा जरा यथा मृत्युः यथा कालो यथा विधिः ।नित्यम् न प्रतिहन्यन्ते सर्व भूतेषु लक्ष्मण ।तथा अहम् क्रोध संयुक्तो न निवार्यो अस्मि असंशयम् ॥३-६४-७६॥
verses.transliteration: yathā jarā yathā mṛtyuḥ yathā kālo yathā vidhiḥ ।nityam na pratihanyante sarva bhūteṣu lakṣmaṇa ।tathā aham krodha saṁyukto na nivāryo asmi asaṁśayam ॥3-64-76॥

verses.sloka: पुरा इव मे चारु दतीम् अनिन्दिताम्दिशन्ति सीताम् यदि न अद्य मैथिलीम् ।सदेव गन्धर्व मनुष्य पन्नगम्जगत् स शैलम् परिवर्तयामि अहम् ॥३-६४-७७॥
verses.transliteration: purā iva me cāru datīm aninditāmdiśanti sītām yadi na adya maithilīm ।sadeva gandharva manuṣya pannagamjagat sa śailam parivartayāmi aham ॥3-64-77॥
